data.gender_notes: Hermes is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Hermes is recorded with the meaning “Messenger of the gods”. Hermes is a Biblical name meaning “Messenger of the gods”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. Note: this meaning has not been independently verified against a classical lexicon or primary source and is flagged for source verification.

in_greek.name: Ἑρμῆς

faq.a: Wednesday is the traditional association for Hermes. This is interpretive.
